$comment: D-CG-INLINE-MULTIBLOCK-INTO-COMPUTED-GOTO-HOST execution witness: a computed-goto threaded interpreter (`&&label`+`goto *p`) whose EVERY address-taken label block also calls the MULTI-BLOCK inline-eligible helper `adjust`. Under the `release` shippedPipeline (Inlining ON) `main` routes through MultiBlockInliner and every address-taken block is SPLIT at its call, so the run exercises both new caller-host arms: BlockAddress's block-id payload remapped through the block-ENTRY map (blockMap_), and IndirectBr's successors remapped 1:1. The exit code is what discriminates — a computed goto landing on the wrong block still yields well-formed IR. `op_add` is entered TWICE (prog[0], prog[2]), the second time through the BlockAddress, so remapping the address to the split chain's CONTINUATION instead of its entry skips one `adjust` and exits 113; `trace` is a base-4 register of which labels ran in which order, so any wrong-label landing or dropped IndirectBr edge moves the code too. adjust(x)=x>100?x-50:(x<0?-x:x+3); acc 1 -> 4 -> *2=14 -> 17 -> -7=13, trace 1 -> 6 -> 25 -> 103, exit 13+103=116. RED-ON-DISABLE (REMOVE-direction, src/opt/passes/inlining.cpp): delete MultiBlockInliner::emitCallerInst's BlockAddress arm and the verbatim addInst fallback copies the OLD block id; delete MultiBlockInliner::emitTerminator's IndirectBr arm and the switch default aborts the compile. Witnessed under baseline AND release.
